label: Chat in the browser, nothing connected
authored_by: the site, as a starting point — not measured, not surveyed; the first thing to argue with
description: I paste things in and read what comes back. That is the whole mandate, and the honest baseline: a chat window with nothing connected should be able to do nothing else.

provenance.note: Promoted from mandates/chat-no-connectors.json. `unstated` is computed here as the primitives the mandate names neither way; the pack leaves it implicit. A mandate is elicited, not measured: these are first drafts written to be argued with.
